calendarRule: Four fixed councils in 1452: January strategic focus, April fortress warning, June Orban and December Union. February, March, May, July, August, September, October and November are selectable. January 1453 brings the Genoese and, provisionally, Hungry Mouths; February 1453 is selectable. March resolves the outpost castles, then Easter and the siege. Chain, commander and fleet orders are selectable preparations, not mandatory March events. Career options use persistent main-menu achievement counts earned across games.

events.title: A Fortress Rises on the Bosphorus
events.description:
The report reaches you before the morning bells. Across the water, on the European shore of the Bosphorus, Mehmed’s men are clearing ground. Stone barges crowd the landing; carts drag timber up the slope; armed guards turn away anyone who asks too many questions.

Your pilots need no architect to explain the plan. A fortress there could put the grain ships of the Black Sea beneath Ottoman guns. The walls of Constantinople might still stand while its markets empty.

Notaras spreads a chart across the council table. “We can protest, Majesty. We can buy what we shall need while the passage remains open. Or we can learn precisely what the Sultan is building.”

Beyond the windows, merchant sails move quietly towards the strait. For the moment, they are still passing.

choices.label: “Send a formal protest—and copies to every court that still calls us an ally.”
choices.text: PROPOSED: −1,000 gold; public morale +5. Record a diplomatic warning that can improve the terms of a later Foreign Aid choice; size of that later benefit TBD. Construction continues. The public sees resistance, but parchment will not stop the guns.

choices.label: “Let them raise their towers. We shall fill our granaries.”
choices.text: PROPOSED: −6,000 gold; +3,000 provisions bought while ships can still pass. No effect on construction. Immediate food instead of diplomatic or intelligence benefit; affordability required.

choices.label: “Put our people among the boatmen and suppliers. I want plans, names and watch schedules.”
choices.text: PROPOSED: −1,500 gold; +1 secret; record fortress reconnaissance. Suggested later benefit: +10 percentage points to one covert Rumeli operation, capped at 95%, then consume the reconnaissance benefit. No career unlock and no free assault. If the Rumeli event is unavailable, the secret remains useful.

choices.label: “Our answer will be given from our own walls. Spend nothing on gestures.”
choices.text: PROPOSED: no resource cost; troop morale +5 from a clear defensive commitment. No extra grain, intelligence or diplomatic leverage; construction continues. A defensible economy choice, not a disguised punishment.

questions: DECIDE: numerical balance of the four options, including the later diplomatic and reconnaissance modifiers.

events.title: Siege Preparation — Naval Warfare
events.description: The admirals ask for ships. The shipwrights ask for timber. The pilots ask for silence. You can pay for one serious naval preparation before the harbour becomes a battlefield. Where should the money go?
events.notes: NEW CREATIVE DRAFT requested by the user; not imported or an existing game event. Base selectable for evaluation, not a career unlock. Choose one investment, not all five. All prices, durations and percentages below are suggestions. Distinct from fleet orders: this builds capacity or infrastructure rather than choosing the military fleet’s mission.

choices.label: Charter armed merchantmen
choices.text: Suggested: −6,000 gold; +3 ships with hired crews before the siege. Advantage: immediate fleet strength. Trade-off: contracted crews require pay; arrears consequences TBD.

choices.label: Prepare the repair yards
choices.text: Suggested: −4,000 gold and −30 materials. First two damaged fleets returning to harbour restore 20% of damaged surviving hulls. Repair damage only: no resurrection of ships sunk in battle.

choices.label: Establish naval magazines
choices.text: Suggested: −3,000 gold and −500 provisions now; cover the first three fleet sorties’ supply charges. If no per-sortie supply system is adopted, redesign this option rather than add a bonus without a cost it can offset.

choices.label: Create a hidden anchorage on the Ottoman coast
choices.text: Suggested: −4,500 gold and commit one spy until the base is ready. One successful raid can return to the base and avoid one interception check. Risk proposal: 20% discovery per use; discovery closes the base and may capture its personnel. Route, timing and capture resolution TBD.

choices.label: Train harbour pilots and signal crews
choices.text: Suggested: −2,500 gold; +10 percentage points to the first two convoy/interception-avoidance checks, capped at 95%. No bonus to naval battle damage. Works without an intact chain; defending the chain requires it to exist.

questions: DECIDE: which naval investments and proposed costs should enter the final event?
DECIDE: compatible damage/repair, sortie-supply and interception rules before translating these bonuses into gameplay.

events.title: Ottoman Special Action — Attack Galata
events.when: During siege · eligible Ottoman land action
events.description: Galata has abandoned neutrality. Ottoman forces may now choose to attack the district and its defences.
events.notes: Eligibility implemented in the developer rules preview. Requires imperial or Giovanni control, active siege and zero remaining land-operation delay. axes: Galata state: neutral / imperial / giovanni-autonomous / ottoman
Galata goodwill: local relationship, independent of state
Character loyalty to the emperor: per character, independent of role and troop morale
Giovanni ambition and outstanding promises: proposed additional factors
rules: Gift, cooperation, takeover and grant can happen successively. They are not exclusive campaign paths.
Changing sovereignty does not set goodwill to 100.
Only Giovanni alive/present can take his branches.
A territorial promise is not ownership until conditions are met.
Repeat visits do not repeat one-time gifts, troop grants or promises.
Rebellion is conditional on grievances and leverage; not inevitable.
A throne challenge needs personal power plus serious grievance and a prior warning. Granting Galata alone never triggers rebellion.

states.label: Direct imperial control
states.description: Administration and local goodwill; appointed Giovanni remains your governor.

states.label: Giovanni’s autonomous rule
states.description: Negotiate with Giovanni as an autonomous ally; personal loyalty remains separate.

states.label: Turkish control
states.description: Normal allied interactions unavailable; intelligence, captives and future recovery are separate proposals.

rules: Hiring/arrival, pay, appointments, treatment and promises can change loyalty.
Appointing a commander does not create a separate copy of the same character’s loyalty.
High loyalty does not automatically transfer Galata’s sovereignty.
Low loyalty alone does not trigger a coup; grievance, opportunity, power and warnings matter.

actions.title: Send gifts
actions.description: Spend money to improve the relevant relationship. Cost and goodwill/loyalty split TBD; no free repeated bonus.

actions.title: Negotiate friendly cooperation
actions.description: Discuss shared interests, harbour access and guarantees. No seizure, coup or territorial annexation option.

actions.title: Request troops, supplies or a loan
actions.description: Terms depend on relations, available resources and earlier promises. Consumes a finite concession where appropriate.

actions.title: Manage administration and local support
actions.description: Maintain control, address grievances and administer revenues. Initial governor selection does not replay here.

actions.title: Discuss Giovanni’s obligations
actions.description: Visible only if Giovanni is alive and involved. Handle pay, promises and loyalty; renegotiation is not a fresh Who Shall Govern Galata event.

actions.title: Gather intelligence about occupied Galata
actions.description: Proposed hostile-territory interaction. Cost, spies and future liberation mechanics TBD; no ordinary gifts-for-allied-support shortcut.

actions.title: Negotiate a supply convoy
actions.description: Spend one diplomatic claim; cargo and route terms TBD.

actions.title: Negotiate an emergency loan
actions.description: Spend one claim; principal, security and repayment TBD.

actions.title: Request volunteer troops
actions.description: Spend one claim; troop count TBD, distinct from Giovanni’s expedition.

actions.title: Secure the chain anchorage
actions.description: Spend one claim for harbour cooperation; it cannot restore a chain that has been dismantled.

actions.title: Bribe the podestà for favour
actions.description: −7,500 gold; +30 goodwill. Does not transfer control. Repeat costs/cooldown require balancing.

decisions.question: How many persistent achievements unlock each event?
decisions.recommendation: Provisional progression only: Overseas Grain Missions at 2, Rumeli at 4, Greek Fire at 6. Counts are not yet assigned in the rules.

decisions.question: What are the costs, delivery times and cargo amounts for Overseas Grain Missions?
decisions.recommendation: Keep chartered merchant missions separate from military-fleet orders; food arrives on delivery, not dispatch.

decisions.question: What are starting loyalty values and changes for each character?
decisions.recommendation: Use a clear 0–100 scale, but assign starting values and effects individually; no automatic coup at one arbitrary number.

decisions.question: Should a castle gift return troops and give a redeemable claim?
decisions.recommendation: +15 Galata goodwill and one claim. Choose returning garrison count separately.

decisions.question: What survives a failed fleet battle?
decisions.recommendation: 50% of ships, rounded up, with at least one survivor if ships sailed; harbour defence pending new orders.

decisions.question: Which naval investment packages and fleet mobilisation bonuses should become final rules?
decisions.recommendation: Keep one investment per event; use one-use orders bonuses so routine fleet controls remain useful. Costs and values are proposals.

decisions.question: How much defence should an immediate Giovanni grant add, and how do Ottoman attacks damage Galata?
decisions.recommendation: Keep defence separate from goodwill. The positive bonus is agreed; its number and the attack damage model remain unassigned.

researchBoundary: Date-anchor checks preceded the user’s request to stop historical research. All added Galata/Giovanni branches are creative proposals, not historical assertions.
acceptedDecisions: Fixed 1452: January strategic focus; April A Fortress Rises on the Bosphorus; June Artillery Genius; December Union.
Eight flexible months in 1452 plus February 1453. Provisions and Galata are base selectable preparation events.
Hungry Mouths moves later, provisionally January 1453 alongside the Genoese arrival.
Career unlocks depend on the persistent number of game achievements, not achievements inside the current event chain. Required counts remain undecided.
Rumeli, Greek Fire and Overseas Grain Missions are career-unlocked preparation events. Every selectable event is titled Siege Preparation — ….
The diplomatic screen offers routine Galata interactions; the preparation event exclusively offers Varangian seizure and takeover through Giovanni.
Who Shall Govern Galata? fires only after successful capture by one of those routes, once per capture.
Galata has four states: neutral, direct imperial control, Giovanni autonomous, Turkish control. Appointing a governor alone does not grant autonomy.
Character loyalty to the emperor is a separate stat from troop morale, Galata goodwill and political control.
Castle sacrifice blocks Ottoman land operations for 5–9 days after siege begins; troop morale −5 points.
Giovanni can attempt a throne challenge after serious grievances and with sufficient political/military leverage.
One mission for the whole fleet; later changes cost an action; defeat leaves survivors; victory uses Victorious Fleet.
Galata preparation retains six core choices: support, neutrality, Varangians, bribe, Giovanni with Diplomacy focus, gifts/shared faith (+30 goodwill).
Post-victory Galata promise: +15 loyalty selected from +10/+15. Immediate autonomous grant: +30 loyalty and a positive defence bonus of undecided size.
Imperial and autonomous Giovanni Galata can be targeted by Ottoman land attacks during the siege, subject to the castle-induced action delay. Neutral or Turkish Galata cannot.
Chain, Fleet Orders and Commander are base selectable events. Successful commander appointment grants +10 army support once.
Naval Warfare is a newly authored base-event draft with five alternative investments. No fixed Galata treasury or troop inventory has been adopted.
